g.text: adc_sarlogic_ctrl: Self-Timed SAR Loop Controller, Varactor Timeout Timer & EOC/RDY Generator
Organized into 5 signal-flow bands: (1) Reset & t_start delay, (2) Comparator/Timeout front-end, (3) 14-step CLKC tree, (4) 258ps Timeout, (5) LAT_EN & RDY
Band 1: Conversion Window Reset & First-Clock Start Delay (t_start = 94.9 ps @ tt_nom_27)
Band 2: Comparator Front-End (CMPP/CMPN), Metastability Timeout Injection & IDLE_B Detector
Band 3: Balanced 14-Step Request Tree (REQ_B<1:14> -> XG1..5 -> XGA/B -> XGC) & Fast 2-Input CLKC Gate (t_rst = 24.5 ps)
Band 4: Self-Resetting Parallel-Reset Varactor Timeout Timer (t_timeout = 258.7 ps @ tt_nom_27; 205..344 ps across 45 corners)
Band 5: End-of-Conversion Output Latch Strobe (LAT_EN) & 6-Stage RDY Setup Delay Chain (LOG-10 = 104..183 ps >= 100 ps)
Asynchronous 14-Step SAR Conversion Timing & Handshake Waveform
Controller Timing Metrics (45 PVT Corners Verified)
